name: Layered Codecs
description: The suite's layered-file codecs, PSD and OpenRaster (ORA). LayeredImage, the neutral value: pixel layers with offset, opacity, blend mode, visibility, clipping and a placed mask, nested groups (nil blend = pass through), the merged composite, bitsPerChannel 8 or 16 and the embedded ColorProfile; LayerNode compares deep trees without recursion; CodecError (notThisFormat, damaged, unsupported, tooLarge, compressedEntry, pixelCodec). PixelCodec, the protocol apps plug their PNG codec into, with RawPixelCodec as the lossless test stand-in (a PNG signature and IHDR with its CRC, then Float32 components; depth 8 or 16, other bytes throw pixelCodec). ByteReader: big-endian and little-endian reads, each bounds checked (damaged), with length arithmetic that throws tooLarge on overflow, and the shared IEEE CRC-32 (slicing-by-8) that ZipStore and PNG use. PNG (PNGInfo, maxSide 30,000), PNGCodec (the PixelCodec over PNG) and JPEG.write are declared stubs: their bodies throw unsupported until the image-codecs tasks fill them in. JPEG read (JPEG, JPEGDecode): JPEGInfo (size, components, progressive, EXIF orientation 1...8 in either byte order) from the markers; baseline and extended Huffman frames at 8 bits, grey or YCbCr at any factors 1...4 (box upsampled), DQT at 8 or 16 bits, restart intervals resetting the DC predictions, a float inverse DCT, JFIF YCbCr to RGB and DisplayTransfer's sRGB decode to linear premultiplied pixels with alpha 1, not rotated; SOF sides within maxSide (30,000) and PixelBuffer.maxPixels before any allocation (tooLarge), arithmetic, lossless, hierarchical, 12-bit, CMYK and DNL heights unsupported, a progressive read unsupported until IC-7, and a bad marker, table or Huffman code or a short scan damaged. Inflate (zlib and raw, RFC 1950 and 1951): stored, fixed and dynamic Huffman blocks through a 10-bit lookup table, the Adler-32 checked, damaged on a bad header, block type, stored length, over-subscribed or incomplete code, distance past the output or early end, tooLarge before the output would pass the limit. Deflate (zlib): stored blocks at level 0, one fixed-Huffman block with greedy LZ77 over a 32 KiB window and hash chains at 1...9, deterministic. PackBits: header 0...127 copies n+1 literal bytes, -127...-1 repeats the next byte 1-n times, -128 is skipped; a run past the row's end or input that ends first throws damaged; the encoder writes runs of 3 or more as repeat packets, no packet over 128 bytes. ZipStore, the stored-only zip container: archive writes deterministic bytes (the first path, e.g. mimetype, at offset 30, the rest sorted by UTF-8, DOS date 0x0021, IEEE CRC-32), throwing unsupported for an empty name or a missing first and tooLarge past 65,535 entries or name bytes or 4 GiB sizes and offsets; entries throws compressedEntry for a compressed entry, unsupported for an encrypted one, damaged for a bad CRC, a repeated path, local and central sizes that differ or entry sizes summing past the archive's bytes, and notThisFormat without an end record. PSD read (PSD, PSDRead, PSDDeep): 8BPS version 1 (version 2 unsupported), 1...56 channels, 8 or 16 bits, RGB or grayscale (others unsupported), the ICC profile from resource 1039 (one ColorProfile refuses is dropped), raw and RLE channels (zip unsupported), layer masks, 16 blend keys (unknown reads normal), luni names, lsct groups, the merged image decoded as colour and one alpha only; limits maxSide 30,000 per side, maxLayers 8,000 records, maxDepth 256 nested groups and maxTotalPixels (PixelBuffer.maxPixels) summed over the canvas, every layer and every mask from the record bounds before any channel is decoded, all tooLarge. PSD write (PSDWrite, PSDDeep): 8 or 16 bits, RGB or grayscale under a gray profile, the profile as resource 1039, every channel RLE, a negative layer count, each group a bounding divider then a folder record, luni names, blend keys and the merged image (from composite, or flattened from the visible layers when it is nil); validated before any byte is written: opacity and mask default finite in 0...1 and a composite the canvas size (unsupported), canvas and record sides within maxSide, bounds within Int32, records within maxLayers and summed areas within maxTotalPixels (tooLarge). It has no nesting cap, so groups deeper than maxDepth write and PSD read refuses them. OpenRaster read (OpenRaster, StackXML, OpenRasterDeep): mimetype exactly image/openraster, stack.xml at most 16 MiB parsed by StackXML (nested stacks as groups within maxDepth, the root the first; layers and stacks within maxLayers; canvas within maxSide and PixelBuffer.maxPixels; x and y integers within 2^30 either way, else damaged; opacity clamped to 0...1, non-finite damaged; svg composite ops, unknown reads normal; entities decoded), a repeated or missing src damaged, every layer PNG and mergedimage.png sized from its IHDR and summed within maxTotalPixels before any is decoded once through the PixelCodec, a merged image other than the canvas size damaged, 16 bits when any IHDR says 16, and profile.icc within maxProfileBytes (16 MiB; a refused profile is dropped). OpenRaster write (OpenRasterWrite, OpenRasterDeep): stack.xml top first, one PNG per layer through the PixelCodec, mergedimage.png, a thumbnail 256 on its longest side (never scaled up), profile.icc and app extra entries; validated before anything is encoded: depth 8 or 16, a composite the canvas size, no mask or clipping, no NUL in a name, no extra entry on a standard or layer path (unsupported), sizes, offsets, counts and nesting within what the reader accepts. A group's isOpen is not kept. PixelBuffer profile conversion (ProfileConvert: unpremultiply, source curve, matrix, target curve, alpha and alpha-0 pixels kept, no clamp, a non-finite result throws), its curve passes read from per-channel lookup tables (ProfileConvertCurves, linear interpolation checked against the exact curve when built, with values outside the tables taking the exact path).
